paired_vs_market.method: paired_block_bootstrap[block:game_date; groups remain intact inside block]
paired_vs_market.assumptions: Blocks are exchangeable. Within-block dependence is preserved by resampling whole blocks.
paired_vs_market.limitations: Block length is a modeling choice; results can change with gameday vs week blocks. 500 bootstrap draws quantify resampling variability of the estimator. They are not additional observed games.

power.question: Detect a 0.01 improvement in mean log loss versus the same-time market
power.assumptions: Paired differences are approximately iid given the block-level reduction to unique games. sd is a research assumption, not estimated from the evaluation set being tested in the same step.
power.limitations: 2000 draws estimate power; they are not extra games. Dependence, selection, and changing markets can reduce actual power. Do not interpret post-hoc observed power as confirmation.

feature_registry.name: elo_diff
feature_registry.hypothesis: Opponent-adjusted cumulative results carry team quality between games.
feature_registry.denominator: games previously played by that team
feature_registry.lag: shift after settlement; never the current game
feature_registry.missing_treatment: league mean Elo (1500); flag LOW_EXPOSURE if <10 prior games
feature_registry.leakage_risks: Using current-game margin or post-game ratings.

feature_registry.name: rest_days_diff
feature_registry.hypothesis: Additional rest is associated with higher full-game win probability.
feature_registry.formula: days between a team's previous scheduled_start and this start, home minus away
feature_registry.availability: prior scheduled_start known at forecast time
feature_registry.missing_treatment: null + flag MISSING_REST; not filled with 0
feature_registry.leakage_risks: Using a restated start time that was unknown at the forecast timestamp.

feature_registry.name: home_indicator_absorbed
feature_registry.hypothesis: Home teams win more often; modeled as intercept / Elo home offset.
feature_registry.formula: Elo home offset default 50 points (~54% vs equal opponent) estimated in-sample only on training folds
feature_registry.leakage_risks: Estimating home advantage on the evaluation season.

feature_registry.name: xg_pct_L20_diff
feature_registry.hypothesis: Recent 5-on-5 expected-goal share is a more stable quality signal than goal share.
feature_registry.formula: mean of prior 20 games of xGoalsFor/(xGoalsFor+xGoalsAgainst), home minus away
feature_registry.source: MoneyPuck 5on5 game rows or featured precompute
feature_registry.missing_treatment: null, not zero; model may drop or flag
feature_registry.leakage_risks: MoneyPuck xG is a model; historical version unknown. Season-to-date files include later games and are rejected as pregame inputs.

feature_registry.name: market_home_prob_tminus
feature_registry.hypothesis: Same-time de-vigged moneyline is a strong probability baseline.
feature_registry.formula: proportional de-vig of the same bookmaker's two-way quote at or before T-horizon
feature_registry.denominator: home+away implied odds at one timestamp
feature_registry.missing_treatment: null; paper returns blocked rather than imputed
feature_registry.leakage_risks: Closing line, best-price stitching, or post-start snapshots.

feature_registry.name: realized_starting_goalie
feature_registry.hypothesis: Starter quality changes win probability, but only if known before the cutoff.
feature_registry.formula: not in core; post-game participation is not a pregame confirmation
feature_registry.leakage_risks: Inferring the starter from who played.
